exam_facts.note: Handbook Section 1.B (physical p7, printed p7): 'There are 25 questions on the test.' and 'You will have 20 minutes to take the test.' The handbook states no passing score, passing percent or correct-answer count anywhere (full-text search for pass/percent/score/correct found none); passing_percent is null as a genuine absence, not imported from memory. Printed page numbers equal physical page numbers (each content page prints its number as the first line).
